label: BIOS and firmware
description: Unofficial plugin from gamegrab-sources, not part of droidtop. Finds the BIOS, firmware and key files your emulators ask for and downloads them from retrobios on GitHub and the Internet Archive, or from addresses you add.

permissions.reason: Checks that a file is still there before it is downloaded, and lists the files of an Internet Archive item you add
A file you choose to download is placed in the folder droidtop gives it
